content: A dynamically evolving dataset offers the unique opportunity to track how model error rates change over time. Since each round's development set contains only verified examples, we can investigate two interesting questions: which types of inference do writers employ to fool the models, and are base models differentially sensitive to different types of reasoning? The results are summarized in Table TABREF27.
